messages:
Samir: Heads up — Orion vendor just flagged a customs hold on container CNR-74291, turns out the rack manifests were mislabelled by the shipper. ETA slipped from 03/28 to unknown. We need a quick plan for Dedicated commitments and marketplace reservations.
Jess: Ugh. Which reserved pools are impacted?
Samir: Primary impact on EU-dedicated pools (Amsterdam rack batches A3-A6). Approximately 480 GPUs reserved across customer commits for April.
Maria: cc @Ava from sales — any customers with launches next week?
Ava: Yep, two mid-market customers on Dedicated launches (one GA, one limited). Both would notice latency regressions if we reassign. We can offer short notice credits but want to avoid major reassigns.
Oliver: Do we have compatible spare capacity in other regions? Can we burst into hosted API or use quantized variants temporarily?
Samir: Short answer: limited. We have 120 GPUs in US-West and 60 in APAC with compatible kernels, but cross-region latency might break SLA for some customers. Quantized variants available for ~60% of impacted models, depending on customer acceptance.
Jess: What about partner marketplace reservations? Are they auto-convertible?
Samir: Marketplace reservations are tied to vendor manifest IDs, so not auto-switchable. Need partner confirmation to reassign manifest allocations — that's the blocker.
procurement-bot: PO 78921 status update: vendor ORI-EXP reported "manifest correction" on 3490012300, shipper note attached. Expected customs release estimate pending.
Maria: Can procurement escalate to carrier/shipper for priority customs clearance? Any docs missing?
Samir: Looks like HS codes and rack serials mismatched on 3 pallets. Shipper filed an amendment but customs requires reinspection. Estimated extra 48-72h min if nothing else.
Oliver: Proposed mitigation: 1) Move low-latency-critical customers to compatible US-West capacity with traffic steering; 2) For remaining customers, enable quantized model fallback + notify them; 3) Open partner change request to swap manifest allocations with next week’s inbound shipments.
Jess: I like that. Action items?
Samir: Action list: (a) Maria escalate to carrier and ask for customs priority (+procurement bot), (b) Oliver run a quick sim of latency impact for affected customers (<30m), (c) Ava draft customer comms with credit offer and opt-out instructions, (d) I’ll open a partner change request to ask Orion for manifest swap or temporary reassign.
Maria: On it — escalating now. I’ll attach the amendment doc link and the customs case ref: CRS-04582.
procurement-bot: Escalation ticket created: ESC-2026-119. Carrier contact: +44 20 555 0189.
Ava: Customer comms draft: "Short notice: minor shipping issue causing a temporary capacity shift — we can either (1) move your workload to US-West with minor latency increase, (2) shift to a quantized model temporarily, or (3) delay the ramp by 72h with a service credit. Please reply with preference." Thoughts?
Jess: Nice. Keep it short and include expected timelines and credit amounts. 
Samir: One more ask — procurement, if partner refuses manifest swap we should throttle new marketplace seat allocations for next 7 days to avoid overcommit.
Maria: Will confirm with procurement legal and vendor manager.
Oliver: I’ll prepare a small routing policy tweak we can flip (route-policy: temporary-eu-burst) and the rollback plan.
Samir: Thanks. Let’s sync in 45m to review carrier update and customer replies. :thumbsup:
Ava: Ping me before the sync with the comms final.
Jess: Marking as high priority.
procurement-bot: Update: vendor ORI-EXP acknowledged request for manifest swap; response ETA 4h.
